column5: ★ CORRECTION 2026-07-29: an earlier note here claimed a units mismatch that could yield a NEGATIVE multiplier. That was WRONG and is retracted. The admin key hilo_house_edge stores a FRACTION (default 0.01, validated 0-0.5) and the client reads it as one, so client = (100/wc)*(1-0.01) = 99/wc, and the LIVE POINTS rail (points-game:5313) is also 99/wc. Client and live rail AGREE at a 1% edge; there is no player-visible discrepancy today. What IS real: the dormant money rail game-settlement:3957 uses (100-5.0)/wc = 95/wc, so enabling REAL_MONEY_PLAY_ENABLED would cut Hi-Lo payouts 4.21% - the same latent trap Dice had before it was fixed. Note Hi-Lo therefore runs a 1% edge while Dice, Mines, Chicken and Crash all run 5%; that is a product inconsistency to decide on, not a bug. ★ FIGMA FRAME BUG STANDS: for identical stated odds (Higher-or-Same 30.77%, Lower-or-Same 76.92%) the Start frame shows Higher 1.17x / Lower 4.29x while the Loss frame shows 3.22x / 1.29x. Only Loss is arithmetically consistent (0.99/0.3077 = 3.22). Start is INVERTED and would be house-negative if built. Also carries a "Practice mode off" toggle Casey wants removed
